AMARAVATI – INDIA’S MOST AMBITIOUS CAPITAL CITY PROJECT? | Andhra Pradesh New Capital 2026
Discover the reality of Amaravati City Andhra Pradesh, the officially declared sole and permanent capital of Andhra Pradesh after the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation (Amendment) Act 2026. In this ground report, we explore the massive capital city projects, futuristic infrastructure, iconic government towers, smart roads, underground utility networks, Quantum Valley, High Court mega project, riverfront development, and the future vision of Andhra Pradesh’s new capital city.
